selected_skill.name: frontend-slides
selected_skill.reason: Highest-star skill in the SkillsMP design category; it targets zero-dependency HTML presentations, viewport-fit slide systems, motion, and browser-safe deck delivery.

task_intent: Ask the solver to build a self-contained executive HTML slide deck from local business data plus a live local API, making skill value visible through slide structure, viewport fit, navigation, accessibility, and data-driven visual design.
with_without_control: The only planned difference between with_skill and without_skill runtimes is the presence or absence of environment/skills/ and the corresponding optional copy logic in the Docker build.

main: Static HTML output and self-contained asset checks
Business grounding checks across JSON, CSV, JSONL, and hidden API sources
Browser navigation checks for keyboard, wheel, touch, progress state, and reduced motion
Multi-viewport fit checks for desktop, tablet, mobile portrait, and mobile landscape
guardrails: Protected input, service, and skill hash validation
Reject references to test or verifier internals
Require accessible semantic text and headings

expected_skill_advantage: The skill supplies concrete guidance for self-contained HTML decks, presentation controller behavior, and viewport-safe CSS, while a solver without the skill must infer these constraints and is more likely to fail mobile fit, navigation, or deck semantics.
